info.title: SWIFT/BIC Code Finder API Reference
info.description: Progressively drill down from all supported countries to a specific bank's SWIFT/BIC codes. With no parameters, returns the list of all supported countries. Adding country returns the list of bank names in that country. Adding bank returns the list of cities that bank operates in. Adding city as well returns the matching SWIFT/BIC codes. Parameters must be supplied in order (country, then bank, then city) — supplying bank without country, for example, returns a 400. An unmatched country/bank/city combination returns a 200 with an empty array, not an error.

get.description: Drills down from countries to banks to cities to SWIFT/BIC codes, one parameter level at a time.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name (accepts full name, e.g., Pakistan, United States). If supplied alone, returns the list of bank names in that country. If omitted entirely, returns the list of all supported countries.

parameters.name: bank
parameters.description: Bank name (upper case) to drill into. Requires country to also be set. If supplied without city, returns the list of cities that bank operates in.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City (upper case) to narrow results to. Requires country and bank to also be set. Returns the matching SWIFT/BIC codes for that bank in that city.

200.description: Successful response. The array's contents depend on which parameters were supplied — see the examples for each drill-down level.

banksInCountry.summary: country only — bank names in that country

citiesForBank.summary: country + bank — cities that bank operates in

swiftCodes.summary: country + bank + city — matching SWIFT/BIC codes

noMatch.summary: Unmatched country/bank/city — empty array, not an error

400.description: Bad Request — Parameters supplied out of order

value.message: Invalid query parameters. Provide parameters in sequence: country → bank → city

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

SwiftCodeFinderResponse.description: Array of strings whose meaning depends on the supplied parameters: country names, bank names, city names, or SWIFT/BIC codes.

SwiftCodeString.description: A single result value — a country name, bank name, city name, or SWIFT/BIC code depending on the drill-down level.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
